selected_evidence.requirement: Synchronize the system clock with pool.ntp.org
selected_evidence.summary: Shows the persistent pool.ntp.org directive, running chronyd service, selected NTP source, sub-millisecond correction, and Leap status Normal.
Shows chronyd enabled in the default OpenRC runlevel before reboot and automatically running, configured, and synchronized afterward.

Captures healthy baseline boot ID 9ba34f2d-9361-4128-aba4-8e3e3e34d522, reboot acknowledgement, changed boot ID 2b21cd4a-bfe5-46bb-bd3b-59e121b4ea6f, and recovered chronyd configuration and live synchronization.

commands.command:
set -eu
printf 'node=%s ip=%s\n' "$NODE_NAME" "$NODE_IP"
printf 'boot_id='; cat /proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id
printf 'os='; cat /etc/alpine-release 2>/dev/null || cat /etc/os-release
printf 'pid1='; ps -p 1 -o comm= 2>/dev/null || true
printf '%s\n' '--- time ---'
date -u '+utc=%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ'
cat /etc/timezone 2>/dev/null || true
printf '%s\n' '--- installed time packages ---'
apk info -e chrony 2>/dev/null && echo chrony-installed || true
apk info -e openntpd 2>/dev/null && echo openntpd-installed || true
apk info -e busybox-openntpd 2>/dev/null && echo busybox-openntpd-installed || true
printf '%s\n' '--- processes ---'
ps w | grep -E '[c]hronyd|[n]tpd' || true
printf '%s\n' '--- openrc services ---'
rc-status -a 2>/dev/null | grep -E 'chronyd|ntpd|openntpd|syslog|network' || true
printf '%s\n' '--- configs ---'
for f in /etc/chrony/chrony.conf /etc/chrony.conf /etc/ntpd.conf /etc/conf.d/ntpd /etc/conf.d/chronyd; do if [ -f "$f" ]; then echo "FILE:$f"; sed -n '1,200p' "$f"; fi; done
printf '%s\n' '--- sync probes ---'
chronyc tracking 2>&1 || true
chronyc sources -v 2>&1 || true
ntpd -s 2>&1 || true
